qualification: Exact original OTA bank1 code plus initialized RAM; native constructors, UART44 producer and all selector routes; encrypted original outer/inner dispatch and replies. Only libc/cJSON/ROM AES/base64/mutex/queue/flash/RTC/socket primitives substituted.

synthetic_policy.mid: Explicit selected UART input, not observed physical MID. MID groups select separate tables; never union namespaces.
synthetic_policy.cache: Every numeric descriptor starts with original constructor zero. No automatic physical mainboard report; command cache persists until another command or restart. All sensor/readout numbers are raw, not calibrated Celsius.
synthetic_policy.metadata: Configured name/host and chosen epoch clock; RSSI0. Native unregistered metadata strings stay empty; metadata.mid and metadata.mac are not discovery MID/MAC.
synthetic_policy.safety: Strict atomic types/array/text/reply bounds. Reject status35+ rather than native empty exact-capacity output/overflow. No real UART, firmware flash, cloud or HTTP. Upgrade latches bounded URL with no invented ACK.
synthetic_policy.timers: Chosen deterministic local software schedule over the source record schema; timers call source-qualified cache transformations, not appliance physics.

wlan.boundary: Original parser through emitted ret and native restart entry; model applies configuration without rebooting its host process.
